wiki.title: Mike Yakawich
wiki.extract: Michael "Mike" Yakawich is an American politician who represents the 24th Senate District in the Montana State Senate. Yakawich served in the Montana House of Representatives representing the 51st House District after being appointed to fill a vacancy in 2022. He held the seat from 2022 to 2024 after winning reelection.
